requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the specialty match scoring logic during evaluate_care_facade execution for each provider in the evaluation request.
The system must include a specialty_match object in the provider evaluation response payload.
The system must populate specialty_match.score with a numeric value between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must include requested_specialty in the specialty_match metadata as provided in the evaluation input.
The system must include matched_nucc_codes in the specialty_match metadata when matches are found.
The system must preserve existing evaluate_care_facade response structure and fields without breaking backward compatibility.
The system must attach specialty_match results to each provider independently when multiple providers are evaluated in a single request.
The system must not block or fail the overall evaluation response if specialty scoring computation fails for a single provider.
The system must return specialty_match.score = 0 when no specialty match is identified for a provider.
The system must include explanation metadata in specialty_match describing whether the match was exact, partial, or inferred.
The system must handle missing or null requested specialty input by returning specialty_match as null without raising an exception.
The system must log an error event when specialty scoring logic fails but continue processing remaining providers.
The system must ensure specialty_match schema conforms to the contract defined in EVAL-SPC-001.
The system must integrate specialty scoring without increasing evaluate_care_facade response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined for provider evaluation.
